lines.en: label rindorm15:
I knock on Rin's door and wait for her to answer.
The faint sound of her humming some song I've never heard before is quickly replaced by a series of demands that I have no intention of fulfilling.
: Get out of here, loser! How many times do I have to tell you to stop coming around without some sort of offering?
: Is that...a thing you told me?
: Besides, I shouldn't have to pay an admission to see one of my students.
: In fact, you should probably be the one paying me for house calls now that I think about it.
: I didn't even call you, though? You can't just drop by unannounced and charge me for it. That's an abuse of power.
: I'll waive the fee if you let me in. I'm bored and need something to do.
: Okay, okay. Nobody's charging anybody. I was just messing with you.
: Come back later, though. Kind of in the middle of something here.
: And what are you in the middle of, exactly?
: Waiting for the rest of this body I found to melt. They really don't make sulfuric acid like they used to, do they?
: Can I at least know whose body it is?
: Mmm...not sure. And I think it might be past the point of identification since I started with the head.
scene black
: Doesn't mean I can't try. If you've killed one of your classmates, I'd like to at least confirm which one it is.
: Wait? What? No! I wasn't kidding! Stay out!
: Why? There's no way you have an actual-
scene boundariesredux1
: Oh.
: So that's what you were in the middle of.
: You...
scene boundariesredux2
: Sensei, what the actual fuck?! You can't just walk into someone's room whenever you want!
: In my defense, you provided probable cause for investigation. I was just trying to be a good person.
: Probable cause?! To barge into a girl's room while she's changing?!
: To stop the...dissolving of a body?
: There is obviously no body!
: There is very much a body. Just not one I expected to see this much of so early on.
scene boundariesredux3
: Yeah, you're telling me...
: So...what's new?
: Are you fucking kidding?
: What-
scene boundariesredux4
: Get the fuck out of here, dude! I'm feeling totally fucking violated right now!
scene black
: See, that was all you needed to say. I'm gone.
: Cool! Bye!
: In the future, it might be smart to tell someone you're getting changed instead of dissolving a body if you don't want them to come in.
: Oh, yes! My bad, Sensei! How stupid I was to think there was a right way and wrong way to tell someone to stay out of your room!
: I'm glad you have seen the error of your ways.
: Fuck you, jerk!
: What did you just throw at the door?
: A fucking book. And now I have to go back to the door and pick it up because it landed halfway open and I don't want the cover bending.
: So, you're still naked and right on the other side of this door right now?
: I wasn't naked! I just didn't have a bra on!
: Oh, so it's fine if I come back in?
: Touch that fucking door knob again and I swear to god I will actually find a way to procure sulfuric acid.
I find myself back out in the hall, speaking through the door to a factually not naked Rin.
Needless to say, she is mad. Which she has every right to be.
I made the conscious decision to invade her privacy for the sake of a joke and am now paying the price for it.
But do I regret that even a little? Absolutely not.
In fact, I'd do it all over again if I didn't think she would actually find some way to dissolve my body in sulfuric acid.
: Are you still there?
: Are you still not naked?
: You fucking...yes. I am decidedly un-naked now. And I will let you back into the room under one condition.
: Yeah, I guess it would only be fair if you got to see me without my clothes on as well.
: That's obviously not what I'm talking about!
: Just fucking come in. But know that I am very, very, very, very, VERY mad at you.
Once again, I open the door. Just this time, I have permission.
scene boundariesredux5
: Oh no. Your condition is an apology, isn't it?
: Do I not deserve one?
: You do. I'm just not very good at them.
: Will you accept a series of compliments instead?
: Compliments under these circumstances would likely only make me angrier.
scene boundariesredux6
: That was really fucked up, dude. Like, I'm not even kidding.
: Don't do that again.
: You know I didn't actually mean any harm, right?
: You don't have to mean harm to actually harm someone, you know. Like, what if it was someone other than me that you walked in on?
: What if it was someone who wanted to get you in trouble? Because they'd definitely be able to after that little stunt.
: I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
: You mean it?
: As much as I possibly can.
scene boundariesredux5
: Hmph...
scene boundariesredux6
: Do you know what this means, Sensei?
: What...what means?
: As of today...
: Everyone in our class has officially seen my boobs.
: I want to say I'm glad to be a part of the club, but I don't know if now is really the right time.
scene boundariesredux7
: Hah...It is what it is. There's no way to go back in time and change it from happening. I'll just have to...always lock the door now or something.
: To be fair, that's something you should have already been doing.
scene boundariesredux8
: Why? We all see each other without our clothes on all the time. It barely makes a difference anymore.
: I mean...doesn't it make a difference for you?
: Are you implying that, since I'm bisexual, I'm unable to strip in front of my classmates without getting turned on?
: Kind of, yeah.
: That is an extremely rude thing to say.
: It is also 100%% accurate.
: But it's not because I am bisexual, Sensei...
: It's because I am a fucking pervert.
: I feel like I'm getting to see a whole new side of you today, and that's not just because I got to see you topless a few minutes ago.
scene boundariesredux9
: Whatever. You're welcome for the new fantasies, loser.
: So, what brings you here today? Apart from the whole peeping tom thing.
: Just trying to kill some time, I guess. And time normally seems to move a bit faster with you around.
: Well, thanks for-
scene boundariesredux10
: Wait, that was a compliment, right? I can’t really tell.
: I think so? Just like with apologies, I'm not really great at those either.
scene boundariesredux9
: Well, thanks. You’re pretty fun to be around too. When you're not invading my privacy, I mean.
: So, where’s Futaba tonight?
: It’s pretty late. I figured she’d be home by now.
scene boundariesredux11
: Gasp! Does this mean that you have finally fallen for my beloved roommate and borderline-sister, Futaba Fukuyama?
: Did you just say gasp out loud instead of actually gasping?
: Also, all I did was ask where she is. That doesn't mean I'm in love with her.
scene boundariesredux12
: Futaba is sleeping at a friend’s place tonight.
if day < 5:
: Really? Even though we have school tomorrow?
else:
: Really? That’s new.
: Yup. One of our friends from middle[school].
scene boundariesredux13
: Well, mostly her friend I guess. The two of us never really hit it off the way they did.
: Though...there are certainly some things we do see eye to eye on.
: Girl friend or guy friend?
scene boundariesredux14
: Would you be jealous if I said it was a guy?
: Maybe a little bit. I’d like to at least meet him first if he’s going to be corrupting one of my students.
: Well, I guess you lucked out then. Because Nodoka is definitely a girl.
: I'm feeling a little put off by the emphasis on that definitely.
: Let that be your hint on what exactly she and I see eye to eye on, then.
: Ahh. Another lesbian.
scene boundariesredux15
: Our forces grow stronger by the day.
: Also, bisexual.
: Whatever the case, knowing Futaba's not off in the arms of some random guy will help me sleep a little better. So thanks for clarifying, Rin.
scene boundariesredux16
if cafe10 == True:
: Speaking of which, didn't you say something about sleeping troubles at the cafe a few days ago?
: Yeah, but that doesn't really have anything to do with Futaba. Or...anyone for that matter?
else:
: Have you been having trouble sleeping lately or something?
: Not really. It's just a phrase.
: You sure? Need me to come over and read you bedtime stories or something?
: As long as you read some to Ami as well. I'm sure she'd like that.
: Ami can be pretty weird at times, but I don't really think she'd go for me randomly showing up one night and reading to her.
: It's worth a shot, I think.
scene boundariesredux17
: I'll add it to my rapidly growing list of things to do...Which actually allows me to segue into this!
scene boundariesredux12
: Go home.
: What? But I didn't even do anything wrong this time.
: This time, no. But I already had plans with somebody else tonight and you are currently getting in the way of them.
: Is your secret companion also a girl? Or are you sneaking away to-
: I'm gonna cut you off right there and remind you that I greatly prefer girls over guys so, if you're going to get jealous, it should probably be over a female.
: Which it is.
: Going on a date this late at night?
scene boundariesredux18
: A date? Oh god, no. It's nothing like that at all.
: It's just a friend from a different class.
: It might be a little too early to say this, but I didn't think there were any girls you weren't attracted to.
scene boundariesredux17
: It's not that I'm not attracted to her. She's actually really pretty.
: She's just a little too much like me.
: And...that's a problem?
: Would you want to date yourself, Sensei?
: With the penis or without the penis?
: Why not both?
: Okay, I'm going to let you leave now.
scene boundariesredux12
: We can leave together. She's in a different dorm, so I have to go meet up with her elsewhere anyway.
: Wow, look at me. Forgiving you and letting you walk with me even though you stole a glimpse at my delicate, maiden body earlier. I'm so awesome.
: And extremely humble, too.
: After you, Rin.
: Why thank you, sir. You're such a gentleman when you're not being a pervert.
: Yeah, well...it takes one to know one.
scene black
Rin and I exit the dorm together, but she breaks away just a few minutes later as it turns out we're heading in opposite directions.
Without anything left to do, I decide to just go home and call it an early night.
I'm surprised that I managed to get off as easy as I did after the stunt I pulled, but I'm not about to try and heat up the water again once it's finally cooled off enough to get into.
As such, I attempt to shelve all of the impure thoughts clouding my mind on the journey home but, as always-
I fall victim to them in the end.
$ rin_love += 1
$ rindorm15 = True
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
